text: Artificial intelligence, or AI, is the ability of machines to perform tasks that normally require human intelligence, such as learning, solving problems, and making decisions. One important part of AI is machine learning, where computers learn from data instead of following fixed instructions. Deep learning is a more advanced form of machine learning that uses large neural networks to handle complex tasks like recognising faces or understanding speech. Today, AI is part of our daily lives. It helps us find information online, suggests films on streaming platforms, powers voice assistants on our phones, and even improves medical diagnosis. AI is quickly changing the way we live and work.
